12 and a Half Angry Men | "12 and a Half Angry Men" is the sixteenth episode of the eleventh season and the 204th overall episode of the animated comedy series "Family Guy".  It aired on Fox in the United States on March 24, 2013, and is written by Ted Jessup and directed by Pete Michels.  In the episode, Mayor Adam West is brought on trial for murder.  Brian Griffin is on the jury and tries to clear his name.
